title: Scribbling Squid
statement: In a quiet, amber-lit tank of swaying fern-kelp and neatly stacked slate cairns, this miniature bioluminescent squid traces glowing, fast-fading loops of ink through the water as if composing tiny underwater poems. Whenever someone peers through the glass, it hovers attentively, shifts its skin to a polite shimmer of warm teal, and curls a curious tentacle in greeting.
